reviews.text: Omar is the best he gave me the tone I was looking for!!! Exactly even though my hair was mess with colors he did a tremendous work!!!

The stylist charged me for a full haircut to just trim my ends and NOTHING more. I also asked for my roots to be done and she ruined the rest of my highlighted hair. I was new to the area so I know better and will go elsewhere now.

A long overdue review from a long time Mango salon client…first off, you are in wonderful hands with any of their amazing stylists; however, this review is for Mary Rakhmedova. Her attention to detail, care, and compassion from the moment you sit with her is immaculate. She has cut, styled, and colored my hair, and I’m in awe each and every time.  I literally strut out of the salon!

She takes her time and you always feel her warmth and genuine care about what she’s doing. 💛
Just had my hair done by Feruza, and I am so thrilled with it! She really listened to me, and took a lot of time to get all details just right! She did an amazing job! Thank you, Feruza!!!!

First of all, I needed my hair colored urgently, but my regular stylist wasn't available. I searched all over Orlando for reputable hair colorists, and nobody could fit me in. Then, by some miracle, Mango was able to schedule me with Omar right away. And I am SO glad they did!

I showed Omar a picture of my hair from 6 years ago. For 6 years, I had been trying to recreate that same level of vibrance, and nobody had been able to achieve it. Until Omar!

I appreciated so much the fact that Omar did not cut a single corner. With naturally black hair like mine that has already been chemically processed, cutting corners could have turned this into a complete disaster. Omar knew exactly what he was doing, and he took his time to do it RIGHT.

He worked on my hair from 10:30 AM until 9:30 PM. He was on his feet for most of that time working to achieve the exact color I had dreamed of. I cannot express how grateful I am for his patience and incredible talent.

And LOOK AT THIS COLOR! I am in love

Beside from being super talented, Omar is funny, authentic, and has such amazing energy. You would think spending 11 hours at a hair salon would be exhausting, but I actually had so much fun hanging out with him! He made the entire experience enjoyable.

Needless to say, Omar is officially my go-to stylist from now on!

If you love vibrant, bold, fantasy hair colors, GO FIND OMAR! Especially if you have dark hair and have been told your dream color is impossible. You need someone who understands the science behind hair coloring and is willing to put in the work.

Omar, thank you for not taking shortcuts, for caring about the outcome as much as I did, and for finally bringing my dream hair back to life after 6 years!

I’ve been a client of Charles since 2022, and I can honestly say he is the best hairstylists I’ve ever had. He is incredibly talented, professional, kind, and always takes the time to make sure his clients leave happy. Over the years, not only have I continued to trust him with my hair, but now my family and friends are also loyal clients because they love his work just as much as I do. Charles truly cares about his clients. I recommend him without any hesitation.

The salon itself is wonderful, clean, peaceful, and welcoming. The atmosphere is relaxing, with great music always playing in the background, and they use high-quality products that keep your hair looking and feeling healthy. Every visit is a great experience. Highly recommended!

Ali was incredible! My hair color was a mess when I came in, and he took the time to really help, assess what was going on, and explain a plan to get it back on track. He did a combination of lowlights, highlights, and toner, and the transformation was amazing. My color looks so much more natural, dimensional, and healthy. He also gave me an amazing blowout and style to finish everything off. You can tell he truly cares about his clients and takes pride in his work. I left feeling so much more confident and couldn’t be happier with the results. Highly recommend Ali if you’re looking for someone who really knows color!

Took my mother to get her hair done, she was so happy. Soad went above and beyond it was the first time she had someone do her hair that it was easy to manage afterwards. Absolutely the best salon experience she ever had. From the warm welcome to the top-tier cappuccino, everything felt elevated. Soad truly understands hair texture and took her time during the consultation to listen to her concerns. She delivered exactly what she wanted—actually better than the inspiration photo. If you’re looking for a trustworthy, talented stylist, she’s the one.

This was my first time with Feruza and I will definitely be coming back in the future! She did an amazing job, we both picked out the best color that matched my inspo pic and she tailored my requests for my haircut perfectly! My hair feels soft, light, and Im very happy with my results! ❤️

I am so grateful to have found Soad as my hairstylist! I’ve been to her 3 times and each time she has been amazing!
The salon is clean, everyone is welcoming! They offer you water or coffee, their coffee is delish! The wash station chairs are comfortable, they have a neck support that truly makes a difference!
My hair feels so soft, the color is just beautiful each time! I trust Soad with her artistic skills! She’s so sweet too! You can tell she truly enjoys and loves her work! Today we did a melted chocolate with touches of partial highlights, Dubai chocolate inspired!

Súper contenta con mi balayage, gracias Gilmar por tu trabajo y profesionalismo , me encantó y sobre todo, el cuidado que diste a mi cabello. Fue una experiencia genial, desde el inicio hasta el final. La atención y servicio del lugar muy bueno. Eres el mejor!! Cumpliste con mis expectativas 😀 Gracias!!

Charles me ha atendido desde el día 1 que llegue a mango salón y estoy encantada con el y con su trabajo. Siempre deja mi cabello hermoso y el color increíble también. Todos en Mango salón son súper atentos cordiales y educados. Me hacen sentir como una reina!
reviews.ownerResponse: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Maria! We love knowing that Charles has been part of your experience at Mango Salon from day one and always leaves your hair looking beautiful. Our team strives to provide attentive and welcoming service, and we’re so happy to hear that we make you feel like a queen. We look forward to seeing you again soon to continue pampering you! 👑✨

reviews.text:
I highly recommend Charles! I loved the work he did on my hair. Charles works on time and without rushing , he is professional and dedicated, he is communicative, he gives very good information about hair products, he also gives good advice to continue treating your hair at home, he is organized and clean. There are very few star stylists like Charles who know his work well, so If one day you try this beauty salon, look for Charles and have the experience.

Recomiendo altamente a Charles! Me encanto el trabajo que hizo en mi cabello. Charles trabaja a tiempo y sin prisa, es profecional y dedicado, es comunicativo y da muy buena informacion sobre productos para cabello; tambien da buenos consejos para continuar tratando tu cabello en tu hogar, es organizado y limpio. Son muy pocos los estilistas estrellas como Charles; que saben y conocen bien su trabajo, asi que si algun dia tratas este salon de belleza busca a Charles y ten la experiencia.
Amo el servicio de Mango blow dryer bar. Sobre todo el profesionalismo, dedicación y atención de Charle García para mi el mejor estilista.
Leo fue demasiado de bueno me encantó el color y el trato en este lugar de verdad que me encantó demasiado volviera 1 Y MIL veces saben lo que hacen definitivamente

My flight was delayed, so I reached out for a last-minute appointment on a Sunday. They were kind enough to fit me in, and Omar did a wonderful job with my hair! I’m so pleased with the results and grateful they could accommodate me. I’d definitely come back if I’m ever in the area again!
Omar was excellent loved the haircut and color it was my first time coming to the salon.
Omar was super professional and exceeded my expectations…! Love Omar and Mango Salon..

Went to Mango beauty based on google reviews and I wasn’t disappointed! Very professional and welcoming! Friendly staff! I had nothing in mind and Soad helped me make a decision based on my face shape and look and it turned out AMAZING 🔥 will definitely be back!!

Mary is amazing! From start to finish she absolutely nailed it. She asked lots of questions and made sure I was comfortable and getting exactly what I wanted. I can honestly say it’s the best hair I’ve ever had! I will definitely be back, thank you Mary!
The best salon in Orlando! Highly recommended
Had the absolute best experience at Mango Blow Dry Bar today! Saud was amazing and made me feel absolutely radiant! I love my new hair and will definitely be coming back 💗

This was my first visit to Mango Blow Dry Bar & Spa, and it was a great experience! My stylist, Soad, was absolutely amazing. I asked if she could take my hair to a platinum blonde shade, I expected it might take a few sessions, but she confidently said she could achieve it that day. She was so kind and made me feel like a total superstar. I highly recommend Soad for all your hair needs!

I visit this salon every so often when visiting my parents who live nearby and it’s the absolute BEST!! Everyone is great but Mary has become my go to person for hair cuts and blowouts- she is so kind, patient and just *gets* what I want. She also gives the best head massages during hair washes. So thankful I found her!
Feruza always does wonders with my hair! ✨ I leave her chair feeling refreshed, confident, and absolutely loving the result. I can’t recommend her enough — she’s a true expert in what she does!
Omg, love this place! Feruza did a fabulous job on my hair. You’ll be seeing me soon❤️.
